name: io.github.tonyyang0504/taobao-mcp
description: Taobao (marketplaces): me, list_products, get_product, list_sales, list_refunds. Every tool maps to

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TAOBAO_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AppKey of your Taobao Open Platform (TOP) application (open.taobao.com console).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TAOBAO_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: AppSecret of the same application; signs every call as upper-case MD5(secret + parameters sorted by name as name+value + secret) and is never sent.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TAOBAO_SESSION
environmentVariables.description: The seller's authorised session (access_token) from the TOP user-authorisation flow (https://open.taobao.com/doc.htm?docId=102635&docType=1); sent as the `session` parameter. Update it when it expires — the runtime does not refresh it.
